evidence: Changes AddrMan connection tracking in `src/addrman.cpp` and `src/addrman_impl.h`, carrying the P2P area label.
rationale: Prevents valid peer addresses on networks like IPv6 or Tor from being marked terrible and dropped from relay when local connectivity fails. The description notes that because `m_last_good` is global, IPv4 success causes failed connection attempts on an unreachable network to penalize remote addresses even when the fault is purely local.
